anyOf.description: Storage configuration object used to define AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Local file storage details.

type.description: Defines the storage provider type as AWS.

bucket.description: Name of the AWS S3 bucket where the file is stored.

key.description: Path/key of the file inside the S3 bucket.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key ID used for authentication.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret access key used for authentication.

AWS_REGION.description: AWS region where the S3 bucket is hosted.

container.description: Name of the Azure Blob Storage container.

blob.description: Path/name of the blob inside the Azure container.

type.description: Defines the storage provider type as Local.

path.description: Absolute or relative path of the local file.

files.description: Optional file uploads configuration. Use Local/AWS/Azure source storage config, or a mapping of multipart field names to local file paths.
